rows.outcome: A standard user installs the self-contained MSI without a separate .NET runtime.
The exact installed executable starts and survives an observation interval.

rows.outcome: Repair restores the same payload while preserving application data.
Uninstall removes installer-owned resources and preserves settings, capture and queue bytes.

rows.manualEvidence: Interactive tray and Start Menu observation

rows.outcome: A standard user captures test content, reviews locally, quits and relaunches without losing evidence.
rows.automatedEvidence: Existing unit tests and host build

rows.outcome: A second standard-user profile has independent HKCU registration and Jazz data.
rows.manualEvidence: Two authenticated profile runs linked by run ID; isolation is operator attestation, not automatic cross-profile inspection

rows.outcome: Microphone allow, deny and revoke states are represented honestly.
rows.manualEvidence: Real microphone and Windows privacy settings

rows.outcome: Scaling, mixed displays, elevated targets and secure desktop fail or degrade explicitly.

rows.outcome: Unsigned SmartScreen and organizational policy behavior is recorded, not conflated with MSI correctness.
